articles.title: 1983년 당시 보도: 사람과 팀을 움직이는 감독 브라이언 클러프

events.title: First Division leaders 웨스트햄 유나이티드 lose 3–1 to 스토크 시티 at the Victoria Ground . 사우샘프턴 cut their lead of the table to a single point with a 1–0 win over 울버햄프턴 원더러스 at The Dell . 입스위치 타운 keep up the pressure by beating 코번트리 시티 2–1 at Highfield Road . 맨체스터 유나이티드 miss the chance to draw level on points with the leaders when 노리치 시티 hold them to a 3–3 draw in the thrilling match at Carrow Road . 레스터 시티's shambolic start to the season continues with a 2–1 away defeat to 버밍엄 시티 . In the Second Division, leaders 셰필드 웬즈데이 beat 블랙번 로버스 4–2 at Hillsborough . Struggling 더비 카운티 lose 4–1 at home to 칼라일 유나이티드 . 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 boost their promotion push with a 4–2 home win over 포츠머스 . Brighton give their hopes of an instant return to the First Division a major boost by beating 찰턴 애슬레틱 7–0 at the Goldstone Ground . Fallen giants 리즈 유나이티드 lose 5–1 at Shrewsbury .
In the first fully televised Football League match for 23 years, 토트넘 홋스퍼 beat 노팅엄 포리스트 2–1 at White Hart Lane.

Despite the lack of First Division today, all 22 Second Division clubs are in action. Craven Cottage is the scene of an eight-goal thriller in which 첼시 boost their promotion push with a 5–3 away win over West London rivals 풀럼 .
England keep their faint hopes of European Championship qualification alive by beating Hungary 3–0 in Budapest in their penultimate qualifying game, but Denmark remain top of the group.

First Division action returns with 맨체스터 유나이티드 beating 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 3–0 at Old Trafford to go top of the First Division, with 웨스트햄 유나이티드's lead of the table being ended by a 3–1 home defeat to 리버풀. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 are still without a victory nine games into the season after losing 3–2 at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼.
노팅엄 포리스트 beat neighbours 노츠 카운티 3–1 at the City Ground in the only First Division action of the day.
코번트리 시티 sign 21-year-old full-back Stuart Pearce from Alliance Premier League side Wealdstone .

맨체스터 유나이티드 remain top of the First Division with a 1–0 win over 선덜랜드 at Roker Park . A mid-table clash at Highbury sees 아스널 beat 노팅엄 포리스트 4–1. 레스터 시티 claim their second point of the season with a 2–2 draw at 입스위치 타운, but are still winless after 10 league games.
The only league action of the day sees 울버햄프턴 원더러스 draw 1–1 at home to local rivals 애스턴 빌라 in a First Division, making it three points after 10 games, but still no league victories.

Giant-killings in the second round of the Football League Cup , as third-tier clubs 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 and 윔블던 knock out 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 노팅엄 포리스트 . Elsewhere in round two, 리즈 유나이티드 overcome a 1–0 deficit from the first leg to beat the Football League's basement club 체스터 시티 4–2 on aggregate and 링컨 시티 win on the night at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼 but lose out on aggregate. There is no such joy for Bury , who lose 10–0 to 웨스트햄 유나이티드 at Upton Park (12–1 on aggregate) with teenage striker Tony Cottee scoring four goals.

맨체스터 유나이티드 maintain their lead of the First Division with a 3–0 home win over 울버햄프턴 원더러스, who are still winless after 11 games. 레스터 시티 record their first league win of the season with a 2–0 home win over 에버턴. Tony Woodcock scores five goals in 아스널's 6–2 away win over 애스턴 빌라. Ian Rush scores five in 리버풀's 6–0 home win over 루턴 타운. QPR go third with a 3–0 away win over 노리치 시티. The Abbey Stadium is the scene of a goal glut in the Second Division as Brighton beat 케임브리지 유나이티드 4–3. 첼시 boost their promotion hopes and deal a blow to the visiting side's by defeating 찰턴 애슬레틱 3–2 at Stamford Bridge. Peter Beardsley scores a hat-trick in 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's 5–0 home win over 맨체스터 시티.

October draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 top of the First Division. 리버풀 continue their push for a third successive league title as they stand second, while newly promoted 퀸스 파크 레인저스 occupy third place, level on points with 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 사우샘프턴 and 토트넘 홋스퍼. 울버햄프턴 원더러스, still without a win after 11 games, remain bottom of the table. 레스터 시티 and 노츠 카운티 complete the bottom three. 셰필드 웬즈데이 are still top of the Second Division, joined in the top three by 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 맨체스터 시티. 첼시, 허더즈필드 타운 and 그림즈비 타운 are pushing them hard for promotion.
